Author information

Author:

Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics, 2012

History:

2013-09-04 : MGL. Use red_momfbd_*, not momfbd_*.

2013-09-10 : MGL. Moved writing of subfield images to disk (and the associated dark level refinement) from red::pinholecalib. Add a margin to the subfields written to disk.

2014-01-27 : MGL. New keyword: margin. Adapt to input simx, simy, etc., being 1D arrays.

2014-04-08 : THI. New keyword show_plots, change default to not display plots.

2017-01-26 : MGL. Make xoffs, yoffs, xtemplates, and ytemplates keywords.

2017-01-27 : MGL. Bugfix in returned metrics.
